_bus_comment: Maps logical device names to physical RS485 addresses.
_limits_comment: min_value/max_value: allowed voltage setpoint range in V. min_current_ua/max_current_ua: allowed current-limit range in uA (without them every current-limit command is refused). default_current_ua: the current limit the Spellman service sets before a voltage or an enable when the supply holds none - it holds 0 after every power-up, and with no limit its output cannot rise (50 uA if not given). Re-run src/utils/build_registry.py after changing any of these.

arc_detection._comment: Software arc detection, every supply (a device entry can carry its own 'arc_detection' to override). An enabled supply whose output collapses below collapse_fraction x setpoint (or whose current exceeds overcurrent_ua) on confirm_polls polls in a row is latched as an arc -> stat_arc_exceeded -> PLC fault, until fault reset. Not judged below min_setpoint_kv. While the output moves after a setpoint change it is judged against the lower of the old and new setpoints; after an enable, not until it is up (half the setpoint) or settle_s has passed. Read when the Spellman service starts.

source_einzel._note: Spellman 30kV unit (MPD30: 30 kV, 10 W, 0.33 mA max - max_current_ua is its rating)
